session.description: Random identifier of one experimental session.
Pseudonymous random ID generated in the participant's browser (no name, email or IP stored). Synthetic participants are prefixed SYN-.
Provenance. 'synthetic' rows are generated demonstration data and must never be reported as human results. No public behavioural dataset is bundled.
Participant observations are rejected unless consent=true. Version identifies the consent text shown.
True only if all blocks and the post-task questionnaire were finished.
Coarse category from viewport width + touch support. No user-agent string is stored.
Visual clutter: number of items on screen (0=6, 1=18, 2=36).
Irrelevant full-field luminance flicker during trials.
Whether the participant allowed sound; if true, one block is visual-only and one audiovisual (order randomised).
Single-item visual-analogue self-rating 'How stressed do you feel right now?' before/after the tasks (0 = not at all, 100 = extremely). Self-report, not a clinical measure.
Six NASA-TLX items: mental, physical, temporal demand, performance (0 = perfect, 100 = failure), effort, frustration. Analysed as raw (unweighted) TLX = mean of six.
Optional free text (<= 4000 chars) written by the participant. Participants are told not to include personal identifiers.

trial.description: Trial order within session; block 0 and 1 = target-localisation blocks, block 2 = arithmetic task.
Cue modality in the block. audiovisual adds a short tone at target onset.
Number of items on screen (6/18/36) for target trials.
Side where the diamond appeared and the participant's response (left/right; true/false for arithmetic).
Whether the response was correct; null for timeouts.
Response time from the first animation frame showing the stimulus (performance.now), ms. null on timeout.
No response within 2.5 s (target) / RT < 150 ms (flagged, excluded from RT summaries).

derived_session_metrics.description: Computed from correct, non-anticipatory target trials only. rt_cv = SD/mean (intra-individual variability).
accuracy = correct / all target trials (timeouts count as incorrect); error_rate = wrong / answered trials.
Proportion correct on the 6 arithmetic items.
Raw NASA-TLX 0-100 (null if any item missing).
